items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I know Peter Weistraugh. But I know this one saying that ain't nothing.

ctx.x: When did he start to call himself Peter Weistraugh?
Oh, I don't know. I don't exactly know the date or the year. Oh, yeah. But all I know, his second record, then he started calling him Peter Weistraugh. But when that was dead, I don't know.
I hope you don't mind me saying that. It's a very unbelievable story. But it's true. Peter Weistraugh is famous and Alan Shaw is famous. And he says they are both the same man. One of the same.
